root.label: Flensburg study finds increased German climate skepticism

events.label: Flensburg study finds increased German climate skepticism

slots.name: survey size
slots.sentence: In a study published in the scientific journal Global Environmental Change , authors Katharina Gies and Emanuel Deutschmann reported that between 2022 and 2023 there was a big jump in skeptical attitudes to climate change among the majority of the 3,074 people surveyed.

slots.name: skepticism percentage
slots.sentence: Some 59% said they had more doubts about climate change in 2023 than they had had in the previous year.
